events.question: What are the credit card referral bonus rules, including eligibility, limits, pending/qualified requirements, and reasons a referrer might receive bonuses for only some referred friends?

facts_found: Referral bonuses require the referred person to apply using the referrer's unique link and be approved; bonus amount and requirements vary by card (cash back, points, or statement credits). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]
Not all credit cards participate in the referral program; the card must have an active referral offer before a link is shared. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Customers can earn at most 2 credit-card referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the count is based on exact timestamps of recent bonuses, not calendar weeks. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
The 2-per-7-day cap applies across all credit card types — referrals from different cards count toward the same weekly cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The third and any subsequent referrals in the same rolling 7-day window are automatically denied, and auto-denied referrals cannot be reinstated within that window; the customer must wait until volume drops under the cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
Each credit card type has its own referral bonus amount and eligibility requirements. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Referral statuses: COMPLETE = referred person opened a new account and met the bonus criteria (bonus will be granted per program terms); IN_PROGRESS = account opened and still working toward the criteria (no action, monitor); NO_PROGRESS = invitee has not applied; APPLIED = application submitted awaiting decision; REJECTED = user has too many referral processes going on; ERROR = system error (retry later or escalate). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]
REJECTED should not be retried immediately — the agent must review the customer's existing referral activity first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]
A successful get_referral_link call creates a referral record with status 'NO_PROGRESS'; the referred person then uses the link to apply. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Before providing a referral link, the agent must confirm the specific card has a documented referral program and that the customer's understanding of terms matches documentation; if no program exists, terms are wrong, or the referral would be auto-rejected, explain why and do not provide a link (and do not transfer to a human). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Platinum Rewards Card: $100 per referral; referred friend must spend at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; self-referrals and duplicate applications do not qualify; referrer's account must be in good standing to receive bonuses promptly. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_008]

Silver Rewards Card: 75 per referral; referred person must be approved and spend at least $750 within 60 days of account opening; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; bonus posts within one to two billing cycles after the requirement is met. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_011]

EcoCard: 50 per referral; referred person must be approved and spend at least $500 within 60 days of account opening; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; bonus posts within one to two billing cycles after the requirement is met. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_011]

Business Gold Rewards Card: $200 per referral; referred business must spend $7,500 within 90 days of account opening; up to 8 referral bonuses per calendar year; program accepts new referrals only until 2025-09-15; self-referrals not permitted; if the referral applies without the referrer's link the referral may not be attributed. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_010]

Business Silver Rewards Card: $100 per referral; referred business must spend at least $3,000 within 90 days of account opening; up to 10 referral bonuses per calendar year; referral must go through the official referral channel so the application is tracked. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_013]

Business Platinum Rewards Card: $300 per referral; referred business must complete qualifying spend of $15,000 within 135 days of account opening; up to 11 referral bonuses per calendar year; the referral must be submitted before the application so it is properly attributed. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_012]

Green Rewards Card (business): 75 per referral; referred business must spend at least $2,250 within 90 days of account opening; up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; account must remain in good standing through verification; qualifying purchases exclude cash equivalents, certain fees, and returned transactions. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_010]

Silver Zoom Card: $150 per referral; referred logistics business must complete $7,500 in purchases within 90 days of account opening; capped at 10 bonuses per calendar year; no new referrals accepted after 2025-10-01; only one referrer is credited per approved account; if the referred business returns purchases or misses the requirement, no bonus is issued. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_011]

Referral status can be tracked at any time in the Rho-Bank mobile app or via customer service, with notifications when referrals are approved and when bonuses are earned. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]
A referral that does not appear in the dashboard can be investigated by support using the referred party's name and application date. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_013]

Whether the 2-per-rolling-7-day cap and the per-card calendar-year cap are enforced independently or together is not explicitly stated beyond both being documented.
No documented credit-card-specific eligibility restrictions such as referrer tenure, same-address limits, or new-customer requirements (those appear only for checking-account referral programs).

facts_found: Auto-denied credit-card referrals caused by the 2-per-rolling-7-day bonus limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window; the documented remedy is to wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another referral. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The rolling 7-day cap applies across all credit card types — referrals from different cards count toward the same weekly cap — and is evaluated on the exact timestamps of the most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The only documented handling for a REJECTED credit-card referral is: do not retry immediately; review the user's existing referral activity before advising next steps. No reinstatement, reversal, or re-processing action is documented. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

The only referral-related tool documented for credit cards is the customer-run get_referral_link(user_id, card_name), which creates a brand-new referral record with status 'NO_PROGRESS'; there is no documented agent-side tool to change or re-open an existing referral record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

Before providing a referral link, the agent must confirm the card has a documented referral program and that the customer's understanding of terms matches documentation; if the referral would be automatically rejected, the agent must explain why and must not provide a link, and must not transfer to a human. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009]

IN_PROGRESS means the referred person has opened the account and is still working toward the bonus criteria; no action is required and the agent should monitor until the criteria are met, at which point the status becomes COMPLETE and the bonus is granted per program terms. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

For the Silver Rewards Card, the payout trigger is the referred person being approved and spending at least $750 within 60 days of account opening; the 75 bonus typically posts within one to two billing cycles after that requirement is met, and the referrer is notified when the spend requirement is reached. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_011]

For the Platinum Rewards Card, the bonus is $100 per referral, triggered when the referred friend is approved and spends at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening; self-referrals and duplicate applications do not qualify, and the referrer's account must be in good standing to receive bonuses promptly. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_008]

Referral status can be tracked at any time in the Rho-Bank mobile app or via customer service, with notifications when referrals are approved and when bonuses are earned; general program questions go to customer service at 1-800-RHO-BANK. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

A statement-credit tool (apply_statement_credit_8472) exists for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, fee reversals and similar account credits, but the knowledge base does not authorize or document its use to pay or reinstate a referral bonus that was auto-denied under the rolling-window cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

The checking-account analogue of this rule confirms the pattern: after a rolling-window rejection the customer must wait until the oldest qualifying referral ages out of the window, at which point they become eligible again — the denied record itself is not restored. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]

Not all credit cards participate in the referral program; the card must have an active referral offer before a link is shared. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020]

Customers can earn at most 2 credit-card referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the count is based on exact timestamps of recent bonuses, not calendar weeks. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
The 2-per-7-day cap applies across all credit card types — referrals from different cards count toward the same weekly cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

The third and any subsequent referrals in the same rolling 7-day window are automatically denied, and auto-denied referrals cannot be reinstated within that window; the customer must wait until volume drops under the cap. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]
Each credit card type has its own referral bonus amount and eligibility requirements. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_002]

Referral statuses: COMPLETE = referred person opened a new account and met the bonus criteria (bonus will be granted per program terms); IN_PROGRESS = account opened and still working toward the criteria (no action, monitor); NO_PROGRESS = invitee has not applied; APPLIED = application submitted awaiting decision; REJECTED = user has too many referral processes going on; ERROR = system error (retry later or escalate). REJECTED should not be retried immediately — the agent must review the customer's existing referral activity first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]
